finding.headline: "The 10-Minute-in-the-Dark Mum"
finding.problem: "I don't have 30 minutes. I have the 10 minutes baby naps. Give me exactly what to do, no planning, no equipment."
finding.person: Patience, 33, three kids, zero free time; wants a core routine she can do in 10 min while baby sleeps, no thinking required.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Format / Bonus (the 10-minute daily ritual — also a product spine)". Verdict: PASSES.
